: Derived from agent/docs/sse-contract.md §Event ordering -> "Non-tool turns
: (conversational responses)", which documents the shape `event: token` ... 
: `event: done` with no tool_call and no recommendation, and states "Both
: patterns are valid. Fase D must handle BOTH."
: Every fixture in this directory (3 real captures + the tool-only synthetic)
: carries at least one `tool_call` (verified by grep -c '^event: tool_call'),
: so the pure conversational shape had to be authored.
